effects.effect:
You have an epic resource called [divine power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-10/divine-power). Each time you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you gain [divine power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-10/divine-power) equal to the [XP](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/experience) you gain. You can spend [divine power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-10/divine-power) on your abilities as if it were piety.

Additionally, you can spend [divine power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-10/divine-power) as if it were piety to use any [conduit](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/conduit) abilities you don't have, as the gods answer your prayers with temporary and unique gifts. If you use a [conduit](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/conduit) ability you don't have that usually costs no piety, you must spend 1 [divine power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-10/divine-power) to use it.

[Divine power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-10/divine-power) remains until you spend it.
